source.name: AirStack category guides
source.note: AirStack's own guide to each category, written for the test fixture. Not a vendor claim and not a measurement.

creative-ai.what: Software for creative AI (image, video, audio): it keeps that work, its records and its people in one place.
why: Keeps the work and its history in one shared place
Makes handoffs between people easier to follow
creative-ai.watch_for: Check how data is exported and who can see it before you commit.
